reason: I'd grab the free tricks and try them at the next party, but 99 shekels for an app I install from a browser is more than I pay for any software. If the free ones get a good reaction I'd just keep using those.
objection: If someone grabs my phone or the call looks off, they'll see it's fake, and I'm not handing my card to some website that isn't even in the App Store for that.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks actually fool my friends at a party and the full version drops to around 40-50 shekels.
